offering_description.value: Publishes sports, lifestyle, entertainment and finance websites and magazines. It sells advertising and sponsored content to brands and earns commerce and licensing revenue from its media properties.

primary_products.value: digital publications; print magazines; sponsored content; affiliate shopping guides

primary_services.value: branded content production; custom marketing campaigns; affiliate commerce management

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands and agencies buying ads and sponsored content; B2C: readers of its websites and magazines who shop through its product links

end_markets.value: advertising; media and publishing; sports; consumer retail; entertainment

revenue_model.value: advertising: display, video and sponsored content sold to brands; subscription: print and digital magazine subscriptions; commissions or management fees: affiliate commissions on products sold through its links; project or contract: custom branded content and marketing campaigns for brands; licensing or royalties: licensing of its media brands for third-party products and publications
revenue_model.category: advertising; subscription; commissions or management fees; project or contract; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and publishes its media brands, takes in content and sells audiences to advertisers; service provider: produces branded content and campaigns for brands and agencies

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide US audience across its websites and print titles, with some international readers online

specialization.value: related lines: sports, lifestyle, entertainment and finance media brands sharing advertisers and digital audiences

distribution_channels.value: online: its own websites, apps and social media channels; direct sales: in-house ad sales teams selling to brands and agencies; partners / resellers: ad networks and programmatic advertising platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: advertising and endorsement rules such as FTC disclosure guidelines, plus state and federal data privacy laws

notes: Its brand portfolio has changed through sales and acquisitions, so current holdings may differ from this description.
